title: CrohnsDataSource
description: Schema for scraped data sources powering the Crohn's disease Q&A application

id.description: Unique identifier for this source record (UUID)

scraped_content.description: Full article copy extracted from the URL

scrape_method.description: How the content was captured: 'scraped' = automated fetch, 'manual' = copy-pasted by hand

confidence_pct.description: Estimated percentage of article content successfully scraped and accurately stored

scraped_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the URL was scraped (e.g. 2026-06-03T14:32:00Z)

keywords.description: Auto-generated keywords extracted from the article content

notes.description: Manual notes to be added in the future (e.g. source quality, update reminders)
